title: Tension in OA
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the tension in string OA as 20 N.

title: Friction Magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the frictional force on object B as 10√3 N.

title: Friction Direction
description: Important Criteria: Correctly identifies the direction of the frictional force as horizontal and to the left.

title: Vertical Equilibrium at O
description: Important Criteria: Applies vertical force equilibrium at point O, relating F_OA, F_OC, and the angle θ.

title: Horizontal Equilibrium at O
description: Important Criteria: Applies horizontal force equilibrium at point O, relating F_OA, F_OB, and the angle θ.

title: Equilibrium of Object B
description: Important Criteria: Recognizes that the horizontal tension F_OB is balanced by the static friction on object B.

title: Tension in OC
description: Optional Criteria: Explicitly states or uses that the tension in the vertical string OC equals the weight of object A (10 N).

title: Sign/Trigonometry Error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Makes a sign error in force components or misapplies trigonometric functions (e.g., uses sin instead of cos for vertical).

title: Direction Omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Omits or incorrectly states the direction of the frictional force.
